rejected.what: Pooltable (jdastine), CC BY
rejected.why: SPEC 16.17.4: shipped on 22 Nov, retired on 23 Nov. Compared at the high tier on the GPU, from 2.5 m: its own maps are a drawn dark wood that rendered as a black mass and a mottled cloth; re-surfaced in the app's walnut and cloth it still had flat rails with no sights, a crude cushion line and no balls (a ball on its cloth would stand above the 0.86 m box), and it was squeezed 11 % in depth. The generated table (rails with pearl sights, felt cushions, leather pocket cups, turned legs, fifteen balls racked inside the box) read more like a real table, so it is back.
